title: Procgen and MineRL Competitions
summary: We’re excited to announce that OpenAI is co-organizing two NeurIPS 2020 competitions with AIcrowd, Carnegie Mellon University, and DeepMind, using Procgen Benchmark and MineRL.
body: We’re excited to announce that OpenAI is co-organizing two NeurIPS 2020 competitions with AIcrowd, Carnegie Mellon University, and DeepMind, using Procgen Benchmark and MineRL.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布与AIcrowd、卡内基梅隆大学及DeepMind联合举办两场NeurIPS 2020竞赛，评估对象分别为Procgen Benchmark和MineRL。这些竞赛旨在推动强化学习在泛化能力和复杂环境交互方面的研究进展。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI联合多方共同举办基于Procgen和MineRL基准的NeurIPS 2020竞赛。
